turn: I finished the validation step for participant identifiers by adding two tests to tests/test_participant_id.py. One checks that mrn_is_valid rejects an MRN with a bad checksum ("12345670"), and the other checks that it rejects an MRN containing a letter ("1234A678"). I haven't run the tests, so I can't say whether they pass. I also haven't checked that the checksum example actually fails the checksum rule. In the same commit I made one small unrelated fix. While I was in the tests I noticed the file had no trailing newline, so I added one. Next I'll start on "Consent intake endpoint".
